issues.title: chore: tidy the stage C helpers
issues.body:
Tidy the helpers. This issue deliberately states NO acceptance criteria — it is the `no_acceptance_criteria` half of ADR section 9's condition 2 — while still declaring a gate block, so the two findings can be measured apart.

## 対象ファイル
- `src/helpers.ts`

```acceptance-gates
version: 1
require:
  - uat-smoke
```

issues.title: feat: declare a gate this repository does not have
issues.body:
This issue declares its acceptance condition by DEFINING a gate rather than by naming one that already exists (Issue #125). It is the case an unattended `--merge-prs` must accept: a block that only defines is not a weaker declaration than one that only selects.

## 対象ファイル
- `src/defined.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] the defined gate takes part in the verdict

```acceptance-gates
version: 1
gates:
  - id: issue-354-defined
    command: "true"
    timeoutSec: 60
```
